svg.title: TOPAK C1 — Principal, seat, cell: what an agent is made of
svg.desc: Deployment ⊃ domain ⊃ cell ⊃ seat ⊃ principal ⊃ lease. An LTRO is not a principal but a cell of them: two positions are seats that hold a Persona, a lease and a topic, two are stages that hold none, and a principal holds exactly one seat (ADR-0037 §1). Who is a principal is decided by one test: evictability by an authority other than itself (ADR-0002 A2). Since Batch 34 there are five seat kinds: operator and emergency are held only by people, and both rest on records ratified provisional (ADR-0037 A3, A4; ADR-0050; ADR-0052). A sixth, orchestrator, is Proposed with ADR-0054 (ADR-0037 A5, pending): the one cell that chooses among a workflow's enabled edges (C9).
svg.text: TOPAK · C1

text.tspan: Principal, seat, cell: what an agent is made of

svg.text: Deployment ⊃ domain ⊃ cell ⊃ seat ⊃ principal ⊃ lease. An LTRO is not a principal but a cell of them: two positions are seats that hold a Persona, a lease and a topic, two are stages that hold none, and a principal holds exactly one seat (ADR-0037 §1). Who is a principal is decided by one test: evictability by an authority other than itself (ADR-0002 A2). Since Batch 34 there are five seat kinds: operator

and emergency are held only by people, and both rest on records ratified provisional (ADR-0037 A3, A4; ADR-0050; ADR-0052). A sixth, orchestrator, is Proposed with ADR-0054 (ADR-0037 A5, pending): the one cell that chooses among a workflow's enabled edges (C9).

text.tspan: A principal is anything evictable by an authority other than itself. Whatever is not is at the gate.

svg.text: Resignation is not eviction.
Principals are inside the proofs; whatever is at the gate is carried as an assumption or a declaration.
Each thinker and observer seat holder: a targeted revocation of its Persona ends that seat's lease and
nothing else, so the Observer is a principal on its own (ADR-0037 Context; ADR-0031 §5).
The correlator, and every human grant or thinker seat holder.
Promotion voters, on every rung: the anchor can evict them (ToO §7.5).
Operators and emergency seat holders (provisional): people, Mediated, treated as havoc like every
principal (ADR-0050 §1; ADR-0052 §1).

text.tspan: At the gate: outside every proof

svg.text: Anchor key-holders at archetype custody: removable only with their own consent (B14). Attributable
non-principals.
At degenerate custody a threshold or eviction rule can remove them: they become principals and the gate
moves to that rule (a type change, ToO §7.5).

text.tspan: Cell A (an LTRO) · holds no lease · speaks no alphabet · cannot be evicted as a unit
Cell B: another Thinker on the same Persona

two cells, and this is permitted: a Persona is a property of a
lease, not an identity (ADR-0037 §5).

svg.text: The Thinker's Persona forms it, weights and decoder together; the mechanism's validator admits it;
the typed action is attributed to the Thinker's lease.
The Reader was never in that chain, and no stage turns thought into action.
Lost by coupling the decoder to the Thinker: the record cannot say the model and its translator disagreed.
A decoder seat would recover it at a third Persona per cell; not taken.

text.tspan: Raw emission is retained at the archetype

svg.text: Written to the round topic beside the typed action, as cognitive payload under the same ACL (0003.3),
erasure unit (ADR-0006) and retention (0003.4).
One purpose: re-run the decoder and compare. It recovers faithfulness, not intent, and never admits
anything (ADR-0007).
A deployment that does not retain declares D-0037-2 and loses decoder-faithfulness audit.
One pair per cell, (thinker, observer) (ADR-0037 §5): each cell has two cognitive seats and
ADR-0017's two lineages cover them; CR-10 closes without a third.
Enforced where refusal stalls: the promotion tally and the deployment declaration (ADR-0035 §5).
Correlation across cells from shared Personas is the correlator's concern (ADR-0023 §5).
Across cells, Proposed: along a workflow's clear edges the two Thinkers must be independent, checked
at the tally; every deployment declares it instead today (ADR-0054 §6; ADR-0035 R8; D-0054-1).
spec/Seats.tla: OnlyThinkersAuthor and OneSeatPerPrincipal hold (6,656 states); M_KIND breaks
only the first, M_SEAT only the second; three witnesses reachable.
M_SEAT was the reference's behaviour (finding 1); the grant path now refuses a principal with a live lease
on another seat.
Floor: B10 total and discriminating on all four authoring actions; since ADR-0041 A2 it lets an emergency
seat Actuate.
Proved 2026.10.02: Seats_proof.tla, 110 obligations, each invariant for every behaviour of the module,
not under its mutation (ADR-0037 B25). Certified 2026.10.04: 107 by normalization or a checked proof, 3
LS4 steps no checker confirms (ADR-0046 A1).
The two new kinds have modules of their own, proved and certified: Operators.tla, Emergency.tla
Proved in Lean too, of its re-encoding, and a model of State::apply's seat and lease arms is proved to
refine it at its constants, the recorded traces replayed through it (ADR-0053 R4). That model found an
issuance may change a seat's kind, which validate_issuance does not refuse (G11 item 106).

Every row writes "none" under "theorems voided" and states the real loss in prose: ADR-0023 §6's schema has no "properties lost" field (ADR-0037 finding 6; G10 item 40, as at G9). The Reader's admitting use is owed to ADR-0045 T-0045-26, a trust root at rung 3 only, which no theorem cites yet.
